acceptanceCriteria: Hygiene anchors are de-duplicated in emission order; a test pins a case that previously repeated ':6'.
No existing anchor is dropped (set equality with the previous output).
body: Found in V1-1858 (PR #1161, head 2817789aa, corvint build 664). Expected: each hygiene anchor appears once. Actual: ApplySourceFindings appends both Location and Cause, so INELIGIBLE anchors repeat (e.g. ':6' three times). Pre-existing behaviour, observed by the lane.
title: ApplySourceFindings repeats INELIGIBLE hygiene anchors (Location and Cause both appended)
